clues: This city lies by a river, south east of Bogota, the capital. It stands where the high mountains end and the great plains begin.
It is hot for most of the day here. Cool foothill breezes ease the heat each morning and each evening.
Founded on April sixth in eighteen forty, this town grew fast. It is now the capital town of its wide department.
Huge mountains stand close on one side of this place. Great flat plains stretch out wide on the other side.
Locals call it the Gateway to the Plains in their tongue. An old path here led to vast grass lands near the Amazon.
